scope: Extract the currently developed source-grounded HG chain; no capability development or behavioral testing.

source.content_from: current dirty and untracked working-tree files, not only the parent commit

destination.git_strategy: separate worktree; retains history; retired execution chain excluded from current tree

source_identity.algorithm: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON {relative_path: file_sha256}, sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=False
source_identity.coverage: all production Python modules, DSH .mjs/.json assets, project_catalog.py and pyproject.toml
source_identity.purpose: extraction identity only; not an experiment registration or fresh-run stability result

extraction_identity.algorithm: same canonical map algorithm as source_identity
extraction_identity.coverage: all destination regular files except worktree .git metadata and this manifest, to avoid a self-referential digest

packaging_adaptations: Trim mixed shared modules to retain only new-chain dependencies and remove retired triplet/compiler/runtime entry methods.
Replace eager legacy exports and dispatch with seven lazy new-chain commands and a parser-only preparation entry.
Disable legacy FT artifact consumption and comparison defaults; retain neutral in-memory compatibility fields and the shared weak structural closure.
Remove old-chain tests and a historical absolute-path replay, and align retained fixtures to the extraction boundary.
Write new README, extraction documentation and blank-key environment template; set package version 0.3.0.
Normalize trailing blank lines in retained files for the staged Git whitespace check.

static_verification.limitation: Static extraction closure does not establish functional behavior or stability.

historical_evidence_boundary: Original run artifacts remain in the original workspace.
Historical fingerprints and test counts are tied to their original frozen revisions.
Some retained historical runners require external prior artifacts; old blind freezing does not cover all DSH runtime assets.
